plain: It moves across the sky: about 0.33 arcseconds per year, measured over 14 years (a confident measurement), matching the catalog proper motion.
Its infrared colour W1-W2 = 1.86 mag is very red, like T-type brown dwarfs.
Its infrared brightness stays constant within the measurement errors.
Its SPHEREx spectrum fits a L7 brown-dwarf template best; the next best (T1) fits clearly worse.
